system.description:
You can deliver punishing blows to your enemies, distracting them and keeping them from focusing their efforts.

Prerequisites: Base Attack Bonus +1

Effect: When using a melee weapon with which you are proficient, you can make an attack that disrupts an enemy's concentration. You take a -2 penalty on your attack roll, and if your attack deals damage, the target takes a -2 penalty to Skill Checks until the end of your next turn. Alternatively, you can take a -5 penalty to your attack roll, and if your attack deals damage, the target takes a -5 penalty to Skill Checks until end of your next turn.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy at War
